notes: SR44 Bed Bath & Beyond (bedbathandbeyond.com, now Beyond Inc./Overstock platform). ACCESS: homepage and robots.txt fetch directly (HTTP 200, no Claude-specific disallow in robots.txt). All /c/ category paths return Akamai 403 on direct fetch, matching the prior Home-Decor pass; used the same translate.goog proxy route (www-bedbathandbeyond-com.translate.goog/<path>?...&_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en) to reach genuine origin-rendered HTML, confirmed by resultCount and JSON-LD numberOfItems agreeing on every page (same dual-signal check used successfully in the prior pass). DISCOVERY: checked main nav/mega-menu (embedded JSON in homepage HTML, keys 'tid'/'title'), footer, sitemap.xml -> sitemap/ctaxonomy/ctaxonomy.xml (1430 category URLs, no dedicated best-seller/top-seller URL slug), sitemap/related-search and sitemap/keyword-search-pages (no dedicated slug either), and the site's own /clearance,/best-sellers,/top-sellers style direct paths. There is NO single site-wide 'Bestsellers' hub page. Instead the mega-menu embeds discrete, deliberately curated 'Best Sellers' nav entries (each with its own tid, e.g. TN:Rugs:BestSellers, TN:Bedding:MattressesBestSellers) for only 6 specific sub-departments -- not applied uniformly across the whole catalogue the way 'New Arrivals' is -- which is why this reads as genuine curated merchandising rather than an arbitrary generic filter widget. Mechanically each is the department/subcategory category page with a 'promotion=best+selling~top+rated' facet pre-applied (same URL shape as the ordinary category, e.g. /c/rugs/area-rugs?t=17603&promotion=best+selling~top+rated); pageType metadata on these pages reads 'Guided Nav: Category Page' (same as ordinary category listings). Two menu paths (Furniture>Patio Furniture and Outdoor>Patio Furniture) point to the identical URL /c/outdoor/patio-furniture?t=7908&promotion=best+selling~top+rated -- true alias, kept once. No local-language variants applicable (USA/English site). Every qty below is resultCount+JSON-LD numberOfItems agreement from the live page.
